headline: GSP Crop Science submits SEBI Regulation 74(5) compliance certificate
hook: Routine demat compliance filing from GSP Crop
summary: GSP Crop Science has filed its mandatory SEBI Regulation 74(5) compliance certificate regarding dematerialized securities. This routine procedural filing confirms the company's adherence to depository regulations for the relevant quarter. Retail investors need not take any action based on this standard compliance update.
why_it_matters: Routine regulatory filing with no impact on share price.

headline: GSP Crop Science CFO Pranav Chitre resigns effectively October 2026
hook: Chief Financial Officer steps down in advance
summary: GSP Crop Science Limited announced that Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel Pranav Chitre has submitted his resignation. Chitre will step down from his role effective October 30, 2026, according to his resignation letter dated October 12, 2026. The company informed the stock exchange about the upcoming departure. Retail investors in unlisted or listed debt of the firm should note upcoming leadership changes in key financial positions.
whats_next: Appointment of a successor CFO before October 30, 2026
why_it_matters: Leadership transition at the CFO level ahead of schedule.

headline: GSP Crop Science Limited share price tracked on Upstox
hook: Unlisted agricultural chemical producer price search
summary: Upstox provides stock price tracking and market data for GSP Crop Science Limited. GSP Crop Science is an agrochemical manufacturer operating in India. Retail investors tracking unlisted or lesser-traded agricultural input stocks use such platform pages for pricing data. The company's valuation updates reflect broader trends in the Indian agrochemical and pesticide sector.
why_it_matters: Data page view only; no immediate impact on listed portfolios
